title: Recall potion
description: A potion to get you back to bed
body:
![recall potion by kheyde](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2e7564d33eadfcc876fb578d39630b555d0abdb4.png)

This mod introduces a new potion and the plant used to brew it! With this potion, you can go straight back to bed.
To do this, you first need to find purple lupins, a new flower that you can find in jungle biomes.

![Personnage qui regarde la plante](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/408e5d18db1f1550525ce9876091c590de2c8e3d.png)
Next, brew the potion in a still with sugar to make a regular potion, then add the plant! This will give you a single-use recall potion.

![sucre +](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/246ed504d5a9edcc0ea0a6b6f8d389ced25c3d0d.png)![lupin purple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/00f46441ddb131fa71759af87cf57d012cb613eb.png)

All you have to do now is use the potion! (only possible in the overworld).
